    """Test aggregate with sum function"""
    rows = [
        {"name": "Alice", "department": "Engineering", "salary": "50000"},
        {"name": "Bob", "department": "Engineering", "salary": "60000"},
        {"name": "Charlie", "department": "Marketing", "salary": "45000"},
